reproducibility_gaps: No repository license was identified in final Stage 2.
No dependency manifest or complete version-pinned environment is provided for the PINN stack.
The 1D Poisson PINN source comments that JAX 0.2.24 is installed while calling jax.block_until_ready, which the same comment states is only available from JAX 0.2.27.
Latin-hypercube sampling is not assigned an explicit NumPy/pyDOE seed even though model initialization uses JAX PRNG seed 17.
Hardware used for the timing comparisons is not specified in the bounded repository source.
No released trained checkpoint or expected numerical acceptance baseline is bundled for the representative PINN workflow.
notes: R1 reflects pinned source, explicit paired algorithms and evaluation logic, but no license, incomplete environment reconstruction and a consequential JAX API/version contradiction.
